retained_initial_failures.scope: Video profile identity across fresh processes
retained_initial_failures.cause: Stock VAELoader emits built-in choice names from a set, producing different node schema hashes despite the same selected VAE. Initial held-out video admission correctly refused mismatched profiles.
retained_initial_failures.correction: Normalize only that explicit VAE choice ordering for instrumented qualification. Preserve all choices/defaults/model byte pins, retain the initial refusal, and repeat both video calibration sessions. The read-only follow-up initially reached the observer after its owned shutdown; fresh owned processes supplied the schema comparison.

retained_initial_failures.cause: One uv command omitted the repository-local cache setting and failed opening the restricted shared cache.
retained_initial_failures.correction: Restore UV_CACHE_DIR to .uv-cache; no package or environment replacement.

retained_initial_failures.cause: Shared asset database produced a warning; then dedicated user-directory arguments referred to an absent directory.
retained_initial_failures.correction: Dedicated user/database directories and bootstrap creation before stock argument parsing. Failed startup preceded any model submission; retained stage-09-initial-startup-20260921.json.

retained_initial_failures.cause: The initial 16 successful measurements used stock shared temporary storage.
retained_initial_failures.correction: Direct stock cleanup to a verified workspace-owned scratch/temp directory; repeat all 16 model jobs with fresh seeds and exact new runtime identity. Preserve stage-09-initial-measurements-20260921.json; never reuse its profiles for the corrected observer.

retained_initial_failures.cause: Tests indexed the absent submission list when the correct refusal made zero submissions.
retained_initial_failures.correction: Assert an absent or empty submission list; 22 tests then passed. Later expanded focused suite passed 66 tests before additional counter, prior-failure cache and VAE schema-order regressions.
